title: personal kpi weekly checkin - jordan lee
body:
WEEKLY CHECK-IN (notes to self) - 2026-03-11

Context: quick scratchpad for the week. Focus areas this quarter: reduce 95th latency for hosted API, increase throughput for Dedicated, and improve caching hit-rate for conversational workloads.

Objectives / Personal KPIs (quarter):
- Reduce hosted-api 95th p50 latency from 480ms -> 360ms (target by end of Q2)
- Improve steady-state throughput on p4d pool by 20% for batched workloads
- Raise KV/prefix cache hit-rate from 62% -> 78% for customer X workload
- Ship two perf improvements with benchmarks and rollouts (canary + automatic fallback)

This week's progress (high level):
- Perf change PR (serving-runtime): tested micro-benchmarks, single-node perf +7% on half-precision path. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/789 (Samira reviewing).
- Cache instrumentation: added histogram for prefix reuse; initial data shows 64-66% hit-rate on staging (still noisy).
- Traffic replay for customer X run yesterday (INF-4821) — saw tail latency spike on seq_len > 1024; suspected kernel choice fallback not triggering correctly.

Concrete numbers (staging, 2026-03-10):
- hosted-api 95th: 472ms (baseline 480 earlier this week)
- p4d throughput (batch=16): 14.2 tokens/sec (baseline 13.1)
- KV cache hit-rate (staging): 65% (goal 78%)

Blockers / open questions:
- Kernel fallback bug: need to reproduce with minimal repro. Filed JIRA INF-4827 (todo: attach core dumps).
- Autoscaler config for Dedicated pools: policy thresholds unclear for burst capacity. Follow up with infra (Ethan).
- Need storage of per-request cache keys for longer window to debug eviction patterns — will add sampling instrumentation but cost concerns (ask infra).

Action items (this week):
- [Jordan] Finish reproducer for seq_len > 1024 tail (target Tue 3/12) -> create small benchmark harness and post results in Slack thread.
- [Samira] Finish code review + perf regression tests for PR #789 (ETA Wed 3/13).
- [Ethan] Schedule 30m sync to clarify Dedicated autoscaler thresholds (ETA Fri 3/14).
- [Jordan] Add lightweight sampled KV key logging (config flag) — discuss retention/volume with infra.

Notes / thinking (scratch):
- Might be able to trade some micro-latency for better throughput with adaptive batching policy per route; need to measure p95 cost for interactive routes vs background batch jobs.
- Consider a canary that enables updated kernel only for <=512 seq_len first, verify tail behavior before wider rollout.
- Revisit quantization profile suggestion from Optimize team — can we automate suggestion per-route? Useful but risk of quality regression. Add to backlog if time allows.

Quick retro on last sprint:
- Wins: got p4d throughput change merged to bench branch, infra helped set up traffic replay harness quickly.
- Misses: instrumentation rollout was slower than expected due to concerns about storage; need earlier infra sync in planning.

Misc notes to self:
- Link to perf dashboards: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/serving-runtime-perf (bookmark)
- Confluence doc for OKRs + tasks: https://confluence.redwood/team/serving-runtime/OKRs-2026
- Slack: thread for kernel fallback debug: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01234567/p1679800000000000

Questions to bring up in 1:1 w/ manager:
- Are we prioritizing tail latency vs throughput this quarter? (I think tail latency for hosted-api should be higher priority)
- Request for headcount/time to implement sampled KV logging (impact analysis required)

TODO (personal):
- Clean up this doc and move completed items into PR descriptions / JIRA tickets.
- Draft one-pager for perf rollout plan (canary windows, metrics to watch, rollback triggers).

-- end of note --

(Format: messy scratchpad; meant for private tracking and quick copy->JIRA/Confluence fragments)
